name: pocket-bridge
description: An unofficial gateway for using DeepSeek Harness or OpenAI Codex on your own Windows PC from a phone browser.
author: Pocket Bridge contributors

scripts._comment_test_all: Discover and run all available checks. Some require real devices, can affect local account state, or need manual action; review them before running.
scripts._comment_scan: Run before release. The default mode fails on workspace secrets and warns about history; use --strict to fail on historical findings too.
scripts._comment_prune: Retention cleanup for old runtime data. Run --dry-run first. The allowlist excludes keys, devices, and queues.
scripts._comment_ci: Isolated checks that do not require a running local gateway or installed Codex. The full npm test suite needs a configured real machine.

_comment_dependencies: The source has no third-party npm dependencies. Source users install Node.js and, for a temporary internet tunnel, cloudflared. The Windows installer bundles those two runtimes, but not DSH or Codex.
